The array threshold calculation and inclusive selection in `src/curation.py` are adapted from the MIT-licensed [DataComp filter code at 4a8df19](https://github.com/mlfoundations/datacomp/blob/4a8df1992566ef8334773f7152e1855b1f716162/baselines/apply_filter.py) (`get_threshold` and `load_uids_with_clip_score_helper`). The experiments apply that selection rule to a task-specific image/caption alignment score on 8×8 images. The original DataComp CLIP scores and LAION images are not inputs to this run.
